technical-summary: HL02 Gate B lab harness and evidence: concurrent CPU DMA-BUF push vs GPU pull to three cards at 320 KiB-10 MiB, three sessions, every word GPU-verified, 0 errors. Push to the contention-triggering rank with others pulling cuts slowest-card completion 17% at 4-10 MiB and 10% at 1 MiB; concurrent CPU pushers each fall from 10.5 to ~5.5 GB/s, so push-to-all and push-to-pair give no gain. VTP38 revised to a per-rank mixed receive; push-all withdrawn. Producer kernels device-time bounded after an unbounded one hung and wedged a GPU reset.
user-summary-candidate: Measured that having the CPU feed only the card that slows the others is the one host-link transfer layout that helps (17% faster at large sizes); feeding every card from the CPU does not.
